result.stdout:
Quality Dashboard: consolidates SonarQube, OWASP ZAP and WCAG results into a one-page report.

Usage:
  quality-dashboard --config <file> [options]
  quality-dashboard --demo [options]
  quality-dashboard wcag --report <wcag-report.json> [options]
                         WCAG report of every page and its failures
                         (see: quality-dashboard wcag --help)

(When run from a published exe, use QualityDashboard.exe in place of quality-dashboard.)

Options:
  --config <file>        Dashboard config (JSON). Required unless --demo.
  --out <dir>            Output folder (default: ./out)
  --format <list>        Comma-separated: html,pdf,docx,json (default: html,pdf,docx)
  --file-name <name>     Output file name without extension (default: quality-dashboard)
  --zap-root <dir>       Folder that relative zapReport and accessibilityReport
                         paths resolve against (default: the config file's
                         folder). Alias: --reports-root
  --browser-path <exe>   Edge/Chrome used for PDF output (default: auto-detect,
                         or QD_BROWSER_PATH)
  --history-db <file>    SQLite file that stores ZAP and WCAG results for trends
                         (default: config historyDb, else
                         %APPDATA%\QualityDashboard\history.db)
  --no-history           Don't read or write the history database
  --demo                 Use built-in sample data (no SonarQube needed)
  --version              Show the version
  -h, --help             Show this help

The SonarQube token is read from the environment variable named in config
(sonar.tokenEnv, default SONAR_TOKEN).

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 invalid arguments/config, all projects failed, or an output failed.

result.stdout:
Quality Dashboard WCAG report: every page from a site's test run and its WCAG failures.

Usage:
  quality-dashboard wcag --report <wcag-report.json> [options]

Options:
  --report <file>        WCAG report written by Ossa.QualityDashboard.Accessibility. Required.
  --out <dir>            Output folder (default: ./out)
  --format <list>        Comma-separated: html,pdf,docx,json (default: html,pdf,docx)
  --file-name <name>     Output file name without extension (default: the report's name)
  --title <text>         Heading (default: "<site> · WCAG report")
  --browser-path <exe>   Edge/Chrome used for PDF output (default: auto-detect,
                         or QD_BROWSER_PATH)
  -h, --help             Show this help

The scanner library already writes the HTML version next to the JSON after each test run;
use this command for PDF or Word, or to re-render with the current scoring rules.

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 invalid arguments, unreadable report, or an output failed.
